_comment: Canonical NAP for Sunrise Roofers LLC. Single source of truth for every citation, directory listing and schema block. If a value changes here it must change everywhere - run `node scripts/check-nap.mjs` to verify.
name: Sunrise Roofers LLC

address.oneLine: 7320 N La Cholla Blvd Ste 154-276, Tucson, AZ 85741

phone._note: The public listing number: the CallRail number on Google Business Profile, so a call from a directory, schema rich result or AI answer is tracked and still rings Eddie. Use it in every citation, schema telephone and llms.txt. NEVER in paid ads - the ads call asset is 520-210-5284. (Changed 2026-10-28 from 520-753-1758, Eddie's direct line, which CallRail cannot see.)
phone._swapTargetNote: Eddie's direct line. It stays as the VISIBLE number in page text and tel: links only because it is CallRail's swap target - swap.js replaces it with a tracking number for every visitor. check-nap.mjs fails if it appears anywhere swap.js cannot reach (meta tags, JSON-LD, llms.txt, citations).

descriptions.short: Licensed Tucson roofing contractor (ROC #358079) specializing in full roof replacement in tile, shingle and metal, plus repairs and coatings across Pima County.
descriptions.medium: Sunrise Roofers LLC is a licensed and bonded roofing contractor serving Tucson, Marana, Oro Valley, Sahuarita, Green Valley and Vail. Owners Eddie and Viky Guillen specialize in full roof replacement: tile re-felts and underlayment, shingle tear-offs and metal roof installation, with free itemized estimates and financing. They also handle roof repair, flat roof coatings and skylights. ROC #358079.
